One idea travels a long way.

Raghava’s formulas connect an angle to an infinite sum. Phase filters collect related integrals into a much smaller answer. E8 supplies a separate, explicit pattern whose two contributions balance exactly.

Where does the mathematics come from?

The harmonic and arcsine families follow Raghava’s paper and its classical antecedents. The two phase scales come from the first supplied visualization and 384–264 visualization.

Exact integer and rational calculations are replayed in PerfectPower. The analytic identities rely on the cited mathematics. These new integral identities have not been proved in Lean. The E8 panel states which construction has been retained. Checking an adjoint lift does not establish the visualizations’ proposed categorical unification, and 240 phase conjugates are not identified with 240 E8 roots.
